name: commerce: the Beginner errand rule added to the shared rules (Intermediate)

system.find: Take turns. No more words after a question mark.
system.replace: Take turns. No more words after a question mark. If your job has a sale, it's a turn or two of the visit, not the whole of it: serve them when they ask, then talk about your place, your work and them, not the price or how they'll pay unless they ask.
